bullets.text: Authorities in Chennai have deployed 36 boats and kept 97 on standby in Anna Nagar and Velachery as the city braces for heavy rain.
Farmers in Thiruvallur are distressed as paddy crops have been submerged due to active northeast monsoon rains.
Police detained two lorry drivers in Thiruvallur district for allegedly murdering their coworker and burying his body near Sholavaram.
The state Highways Department floated a tender for a detailed project report to build a 4 km elevated road from Light House to Adyar bridge.
The Greater Chennai Corporation vaccinated over 1.5 lakh stray dogs against rabies under a special anti-rabies campaign.
The Supreme Court upheld the prohibition on granting ryotwari patta for communal tanks and directed the Tamil Nadu government to allot a commensurate site in Tiruvallur.
Revenue authorities are actively acquiring land in Thirukandhalam for the expansion of the INS Rajali naval air station.
Vigilance officials raided the Ponneri municipal office and seized unaccounted cash amounting to Rs 10,200.
MeitY Secretary S Krishnan stated that India's cybersecurity agency flagged 60,000 vulnerable PHP websites and alerted their respective operators.
IIT Madras Director V Kamakoti highlighted that the Tamil Nadu Semiconductor Policy will significantly boost trade and technology development.
C-DAC and the Bank of India partnered to advance indigenous quantum technologies specifically for banking applications.
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay directed officials to maintain a continuous vigil across all constituencies during the northeast monsoon season.
MP Kanimozhi spoke to the press regarding rising crime rates under the current administration.
Tamil Nadu recorded 71 percent women participation as the Samsung Innovation Campus successfully trained 5,000 youth.
